manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve an official-index-linked support page where the latest target-form PDF is still the previous fiscal year.
search_queries: 愛生会看護専門学校 高等教育 修学支援 様式第2号
愛生会看護専門学校 令和8年度 確認申請書
steps: Start from the Aichi official-index artifact row for 愛生会看護専門学校.
Confirm the support page lists the target-form PDF section for 令和6年9月公表 and 令和7年9月公表, but no 令和8年度 target-form PDF.
Open support_system_2025.pdf and verify that its body contains 愛生会看護専門学校 and 様式第２号.
Classify the case as publication lag for target FY2026 because no local page, filename, or PDF-body evidence proves a 令和8年度 target-form PDF.

reusable_rules: Treat explicit publication labels such as 令和7年9月公表 as local fiscal-year evidence for the following target-form links.
Keep the latest previous-year 様式第２号 PDF visible as operator-reviewable publication-lag evidence when no current-year target-form PDF is public.
Prefer the support_system target-form PDF over adjacent subject-list PDFs even when both share the same publication label.
anti_patterns: Do not upgrade a 令和7年9月公表 target-form PDF to strict FY2026 success.
Do not treat adjacent 実務経験のある教員が担当する科目 PDF links as target confirmation forms.
Do not infer current target fiscal year from the generic support-system page title alone.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found an official-index-linked support page that lists 令和6年9月公表 and 令和7年9月公表 target-form PDFs, but no 令和8年度 target-form PDF. Source-side PDF text extraction verified 愛生会看護専門学校 and 様式第２号 in support_system_2025.pdf; the PDF body does not contain 令和8年度, so this case must remain publication_lag_latest_public for FY2026.
